name.es: Fuente de poder Mean Well LRS-200
name.pt: Fonte de alimentação Mean Well LRS-200

description.en: A 200 W enclosed single-output switching power supply in a 215 × 115 × 30 mm case, with M4 mounting holes on its base and on both long sides.
description.es: Una fuente conmutada cerrada de 200 W y una salida, en carcasa de 215 × 115 × 30 mm, con barrenos de montaje M4 en la base y en ambos costados largos.
description.fr: Une alimentation à découpage fermée de 200 W à une sortie, dans un boîtier de 215 × 115 × 30 mm, avec des trous de fixation M4 sur le fond et sur les deux grands côtés.
description.pt: Uma fonte comutada fechada de 200 W com uma saída, numa caixa de 215 × 115 × 30 mm, com furos de montagem M4 na base e nos dois lados compridos.

governing.designation: Mean Well LRS-200 series, Case No. 207

sources.title: Mean Well LRS-200 series specification (Case No. 207 mechanical drawing)
sources.supports: case 215 × 115 × 30 mm, tolerance ±1; base 4-M4 L=3 mm on 150 × 50 mm, 32.5 mm from the ends and long edges; sides 4-M4 (both sides) L=5 mm, 150 mm apart, 12.5 mm above the base; 0.66 kg

frame_convention: Origin at the centre of the base footprint, on the bottom face. +x runs along the 215 mm length away from the terminal block (which is at the x = −107.5 end); +y across the 115 mm width; +z up, the top at z = 30. The base holes sit at (±75, ±25, 0); the side holes at (±75, ±57.5, 12.5).

review_status.note: Drafted in one pass by an agent (P4-STD lane, 2026-10-02); facts read from the cited sources on the access date; no language facet has had a native review.

notes: All mounting holes are M4. Positions are the drawing's nominal values; its general tolerance is ±1 mm. Electrical ratings are deliberately not restated: they are per output-voltage model.

envelope.note: The case, 215 x 115 x 30, from its base.
